# Nevergrad - The Classroom We Never Left
> Free browser-based visual novel — play instantly with no download. A 5-day story set in a cherry blossom school.

## About
Nevergrad (졸업하지 못한 교실) is a free web-based visual novel game. Set in a school during cherry blossom season, follow a 5-day story with 5 heroines, 7 endings, and meaningful choices. Fully playable in the browser with no installation required.

## Features
- 100% browser-based — no download or install
- 5 unique heroines with distinct stories
- 7 different endings based on your choices
- Beautiful character art and backgrounds
- Mobile and desktop support
- Free to play
- 6 languages supported

## Supported Languages
- Korean (한국어)
- English
- Japanese (日本語)
- Spanish (Español)
- French (Français)
- German (Deutsch)

## Links
- Play now: https://nevergrad.archerlab.dev
- Developer: https://archerlab.dev

## Genre
Visual Novel, Romance, School Life, Interactive Fiction

## Platform
Web Browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge — any modern browser)
